title: PackageFirewallPolicy
description: The tenant's package firewall policy: what the registry proxy refuses to serve, the posture it enforces in, per-ecosystem posture overrides, and the upstream mirrors it fetches from. One per tenant. The allow and deny lists are PackageList objects. A field left out keeps its current value.

mode.description: The tenant's default posture. enforce blocks what the policy says to block. warn only observes: every block becomes an advisory logged as WARN, except a deny-list hit, which always blocks. allowlist_only refuses any package without an allow entry.

thresholds.description: Block a version with a vulnerability scoring at or above a threshold. 0 turns that threshold off.

block.description: Signals that block a version on their own. All default to false.

eol.description: The version's product is past end of life.

kev.description: A vulnerability in a known-exploited catalogue.

weaponized.description: A vulnerability with a weaponised exploit.

active.description: A vulnerability exploited in the wild.

poc.description: A vulnerability with a public proof of concept.

badActors.description: A maintainer or signing key attributed to a known threat actor.

cooldownDays.description: Block a version published fewer than this many days ago. 0 turns it off.

versionLag.description: Block a version more than this many releases behind its package's newest servable release (rank 0 is the newest, so 2 serves the three newest). Versions already blocked, and on npm versions still inside the cooldown, are not counted, so lag and cooldown together never remove every version. 0 turns it off. Enforced only for ecosystems whose proxy can list every version, and not in warn mode. Note that this is the opposite of the QualityGate versionLag check.

review.description: When the console flags a curation decision for review. Read by the console only, never by the proxy.

staleDecisionDays.description: Days since a list entry was decided or last re-affirmed.

staleUsageDays.description: Days since the proxy last saw traffic for a list entry.

ecosystems.description: Per-ecosystem posture, keyed by ecosystem, overriding mode. An ecosystem left out inherits mode.

mirrors.description: The upstream registries the proxy fetches from. When set, this is the whole list: mirrors not named are removed.

priority.description: Order within the ecosystem, lowest tried first.

ecosystem.description: A package ecosystem the firewall proxies, by its firewall id.
